word: If it rains tomorrow, I will stay home.
translation: Si llueve mañana, me quedaré en casa.

word: If you study hard, you will pass the exam.
translation: Si estudias mucho, aprobarás el examen.

word: If she calls me, I will answer.
translation: Si ella me llama, contestaré.

word: If we leave now, we will arrive on time.
translation: Si salimos ahora, llegaremos a tiempo.

word: If he works hard, he will get a promotion.
translation: Si él trabaja duro, conseguirá un ascenso.

word: If you don't hurry, you will miss the bus.
translation: Si no te das prisa, perderás el autobús.

word: If it's sunny tomorrow, we will go to the beach.
translation: Si hace sol mañana, iremos a la playa.

word: If you eat too much, you will feel sick.
translation: Si comes demasiado, te sentirás mal.

word: If I finish my work early, I will go to the gym.
translation: Si termino mi trabajo temprano, iré al gimnasio.

word: If you need help, I will be there for you.
translation: Si necesitas ayuda, estaré ahí para ti.

word: If I won the lottery, I would travel the world.
translation: Si me tocara la lotería, viajaría por el mundo.

word: If I were rich, I would buy a big house.
translation: Si fuera rico, compraría una casa grande.

word: If I had more time, I would learn to play guitar.
translation: Si tuviera más tiempo, aprendería a tocar la guitarra.

word: If I were you, I would apologize.
translation: Si yo fuera tú, me disculparía.

word: If she knew the answer, she would tell us.
translation: Si ella supiera la respuesta, nos lo diría.

word: If I could fly, I would visit every country.
translation: Si pudiera volar, visitaría todos los países.

word: If I had a million dollars, I would donate to charity.
translation: Si tuviera un millón de dólares, donaría a la caridad.

word: If they lived closer, we would see them more often.
translation: Si vivieran más cerca, los veríamos más a menudo.

word: If he were taller, he could be a basketball player.
translation: Si él fuera más alto, podría ser jugador de baloncesto.

word: If we had a car, we would drive to the mountains.
translation: Si tuviéramos un coche, iríamos a las montañas.
